PLAN "12-week upper-body focused programme for right subacromial impingement - recreational climber"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase upper-body pushing/pulling strength with scapular stability while maintaining pain-free ROM for climber aabilities"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper-body rehab and loading - Week 1":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pushup_to_fitness 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown_wide 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pulls 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          scaption_with_external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_external_rotation 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper-body rehab and loading - Week 2":
        warmup:
          mobility_hips_shoulders 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pushup_alternate_hand 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          assisted_pullup 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pulls 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raises_continuous 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          door_lock_shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progressive loading - Week 3":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pushups_with_band 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_bench_press_heel_up 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown_medium_grip 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row_gpp 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pulls_eyebrow 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper_stretch_shoulder 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload and technique - Week 4":
        warmup:
          mobility_works 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pushups_knee_to_bar 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          assited_pullups_neg 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          rows_with_band 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pulls 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cross_body_stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Endurance and strength - Week 5":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pushups 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell bench press 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          assisted_pullups_2 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_rows 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pulls 4x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway_stretch_shoulder 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength push/pull focus - Week 6":
        warmup:
          mobility_shoulder 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pushups_with_rings 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown_v_bar 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row_kneeling 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pulls 4x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular_wall_slide 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Technique and mobility - Week 7":
        warmup:
          shoulder_mcap 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pushups_iso_hold 3x20-30s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_tricep_pushdown_neutral 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          seal_row 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pulls_2 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_band 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Taper and testing - Week 8":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pushups 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell bench press 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          rows_2h 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown_1 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pulls 3x15..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_mobility_flow 5 minutes

Notes:
- All exercises selected with attention to pain-free range and avoiding overhead loading beyond symptom tolerance.
- RPE targets are approximate; adjust if symptoms flare.
- Week 4 and Week 8 are deload/testing hybrids to ensure recovery and progress tracking.
- Ensure clavicle/scapular control during all pressing and pulling movements; prioritize scapular retraction and depression cues. 
- Include 2-3 climber-specific grip and antagonist training on non-press days if tolerated by symptoms.
